mentions.name: Mobius Clock
mentions.description: A 3D WebGL clock rendered on a Möbius strip that displays 24-hour time on a 12-hour face. The hour indicator travels along the edge of the strip and must make two turns to return to its starting point, yielding a 24-hour clock, while the minute and second indicators move along the middle of the strip and complete a circuit in one turn. The view can be rotated, and a 'Fast Mode' button temporarily speeds up the hands to visualize how the slow-moving parts work.
